topic.title: What Inflation Really Does to Your Savings
topic.hook: Sitting still is a decision with a cost
topic.payoff: Sitting still is a decision with a cost

copy.kicker: Stillness is not neutral. It has a price.
copy.thumb_scene: Wick stands upright on a plain white studio background, arms loose at his sides, eyes fixed straight ahead with a flat calm expression, holding a clear glass jar of coins in one hand while a single paper receipt curls at his feet, the jar visibly less than half full.
copy.send_to: the friend who thinks saving in a bank account is enough
